scope.migration_policy: Read every backend/migrations/*.sql file in filename order; execute unmodified SQL; stop that replay on execution failure, never skip or reorder a migration.

fixture.description: Synthetic nonsecret fixtures. Original tables are populated after 0000; additional children are populated as their real migrations create them. Valid non-stream video providers avoid conflating the intentional 0016 stream deletion with 0009 corruption.

engine.name: node:sqlite DatabaseSync
engine.limitation: Native SQLite pragmas are exercised directly. Transaction modes are SQLite comparisons, not claims about live D1 behavior.

runs.execution: execute original migration SQL in autocommit mode

findings.cause: With legacy_alter_table=OFF, renaming lessons rewrites incoming FK definitions to lessons_old even while foreign_keys=OFF. The later DROP removes that parent; 0009 does not rebuild these three children. Re-enabling foreign_keys does not retroactively validate them.

findings.description: Existing integration fixtures apply migrations before populating children. Empty autocommit replay completes and foreign_key_check returns no rows, while foreign_key_list still names three missing parents. integrity_check also returns ok despite FK corruption.

In an active SQLite transaction the migration foreign_keys=OFF pragma has no effect. Immediate mode fails at DROP TABLE units_old; deferring checks permits the 0009 body but COMMIT fails. Deferred mode temporarily deletes audit-playback and sets audit-quiz.lesson_id to NULL; explicit rollback restores all original rows and links. Deferring constraints alone is not a safe repair.
findings.limitation: Native SQLite transaction behavior, not a live D1 observation.

findings.description: The complete actual sequence adds lesson_videos.platform in 0010, then 0016 omits that column from the replacement table. All four seeded video rows survive, but their audit-tenant platform values are discarded. This is separate from 0009; the omission is documented as deliberate in the migration.

preservation_summary.qualification: This only compares columns present before 0009. Separately, four platform values introduced by 0010 are lost in 0016; referential metadata is broken despite preservation of original row values.
preservation_summary.quiz_attempt_and_question_links: quiz_attempts.quiz_id and quiz_questions.quiz_id still point to quizzes(id); their seeded rows, score, answers_json, question text and options survive unchanged.

safe_repair_recommendation: Do not promote this migration sequence as integrity-safe. Keep production migrations unchanged during this audit; use an owner-reviewed upgrade/repair plan on a disposable populated clone before release.
Before any real repair, take and verify a consistent backup, stop concurrent writes, inspect actual schema and incoming foreign keys, and compare row-level fingerprints, not only counts.

For a database already through 0009, rebuild the three affected child definitions to reference lessons(id), retaining every current column, ID, row, index and trigger. Account for quiz_attempts and quiz_questions before rebuilding their parent quizzes; do not rename that parent to an _old name first.

On native SQLite only, use the documented replacement-table pattern: disable FK enforcement outside BEGIN and verify it is off; create a new replacement table, copy explicit columns, drop the original, rename the replacement to the original name, recreate indexes/triggers, validate all FKs and row fingerprints before COMMIT, then re-enable enforcement and recheck. Never merely recreate an empty lessons_old table or disable enforcement permanently.

Do not assume SQLite foreign_keys=OFF is usable in D1 or inside a migration transaction. Where enforcement cannot be disabled, use a separately validated dependency-aware export/rebuild/import procedure or equivalent engine-supported atomic plan preserving every child table. defer_foreign_keys by itself does not suppress CASCADE/SET NULL actions.
A later repair migration alone cannot unblock a runner that already aborts at 0009. Handle both the failed-at-0009 and already-upgraded states in the owner-reviewed rollout.

Preserve or explicitly migrate lesson_videos.platform if tenant provenance is required; 0016 currently removes it. Restore any previously deleted rows or nulled links only from a verified backup/history, never infer them from remaining counts.

Require the complete unmodified migration history with staged populated fixtures, no nonexistent FK parents, empty foreign_key_check, unchanged expected row values and successful valid child writes before accepting a permanent integrity regression test. No failing or failure-as-success test was added by this audit.
